clauses.quote: Teachers shall receive, for each School, information detailing any differences, if any, in the working conditions at the Partnership Schools and those in this Agreement including, but not limited to:
DCPS is prohibited from substantially changing the working conditions at any Partnership School during any school year.
If DCPS desires to implement working conditions or compensation at any Partnership School that are different than those found in this Agreement, DCPS must first negotiate such terms with the WTU.
If the Parties are unable to agree, the working condition or compensation at the Partnership Schools shall remain the same as defined in this Agreement.
clauses.notes: Status quo stipulation following failed negotiation; effectively limits management discretion.

clauses.quote: The evaluation process in Partnership Schools shall be the same as other DCPS schools.
